description: Save a new AI-generated page, report, chart, prototype or document to the remote Artifact Site library and get its address. Use for 'publish this report' or 'give this page a link'. Supply inline HTML, a UTF-8/base64 file tree, or a completed upload_id. For requests over 2 MiB, use upload_start and upload_write first. Creates a PUBLIC share by default; use share:false for unshared work. To change an existing artifact at the same URL, use update or edit instead. Returns the created artifact and share result; if sharing fails, retry share rather than publishing again.

files.description: Complete relative file tree with UTF-8 or base64 contents; exclusive with html/upload_id.

content.description: Complete file contents in the chosen encoding.

encoding.description: Use utf8 for text and base64 for binary bytes.

path.description: Relative filename in the published tree.

html.description: Complete HTML document; exclusive with files/upload_id.

official.description: Designate the uploaded version as the only official version; replaces the old designation without deleting contents.

operation_key.description: Persist a unique key before this write. Reuse exactly the same key and arguments after errors; recover results for seven days using operation_status.

share.description: Share policy. Defaults to public; false creates no share link.

share_token.description: Token from a user-provided share URL; carries only that share permission.

tenant_id.description: Destination tenant for creation; defaults to the account tenant.

title.description: Display title; does not change the URL.

upload_id.description: Completed upload ID from upload_start; supply instead of html/files after all files have final:true.

name: artifact_site_publish
title: Publish a site
